src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The exemplar is the compact non-background component; all isolated
    # non-background cells of the other color(s) are replication anchors.
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg}
    comps=[]
    while pts:
        start=pts.pop(); comp={start}; q=[start]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in pts: pts.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    # exemplar is largest connected component; singleton components are anchors
    exemplar=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in exemplar); r1=max(r for r,c in exemplar)
    c0=min(c for r,c in exemplar); c1=max(c for r,c in exemplar)
    motif=[[g[r][c] if (r,c) in exemplar else bg for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    anchors=[next(iter(comp)) for comp in comps if comp is not exemplar]
    # retain exemplar; stamp it centered on each anchor, using its center cell as origin
    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2
    for r,c in anchors:
        for i,row in enumerate(motif):
            for j,v in enumerate(row):
                rr=r+i-ar; cc=c+j-ac
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: g[rr][cc]=v
    return g
'''
